latin: Quod dicunt Cabalistae, lumen repositum in septuplo lucere plus quam lumen relictum, mirabiliter conuenit arithmeticae pythagoricae.
translation: What the Kabbalists say, that the light stored up shines sevenfold more than the light left behind, agrees marvelously with Pythagorean arithmetic.
